name: คาถายันต์โลหิต (Cursed Talismans)
units: Lab units (1 = the 0.9-unit stand-in is ~1.1 m tall); Y up, right-handed

shaders.fragment: uniform sampler2D map; uniform float uA,uRep; uniform vec3 c1,c2,c3; varying vec2 vUv; vec3 chan(vec4 tx,vec3 body,vec3 halo,vec3 core,vec3 hi){ float b=max(tx.a-max(tx.r,max(tx.g,tx.b)),0.); vec3 c=body*b; c=mix(c,halo,tx.r); c=mix(c,core,tx.g); c=mix(c,hi,tx.b); return c; } void main(){ vec4 t=texture2D(map,vec2(fract(vUv.x*uRep),vUv.y)); gl_FragColor=vec4(chan(t,vec3(0.),c1,c2,c3)*1.5,max(t.r,max(t.g,t.b))*uA); }
